app.title: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory
app.description: A compact transformer-based language model (~5.4 GB) optimized for low‑memory inference.
proposed_tests: Install the transformers library and load the model from the repo using AutoModelForCausalLM.
Run a short prompt and verify that the generated tokens are non‑empty and the shape matches expectations.
Export the model to ONNX and perform inference with ONNX Runtime, comparing latency to the PyTorch inference.
Measure GPU memory usage during inference to confirm it stays below 5 GB on a modest GPU.
